meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 装上后,数据太大内存装不下或处理太慢时,Claude 会用 Dask 把任务拆成小块,在多核或多台机器上并行计算,仍用类似 pandas/NumPy 的写法,最后用 compute() 出结果。
howto.when: 当你处理的数据超过内存容量、需要把现有 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到多台机器,或并行处理多个 CSV/Parquet 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Dask 读取 data 目录下所有 CSV 文件并计算平均值。
say.note: 会生成惰性任务图,最终用 compute() 计算。

say.text: 这段 pandas 代码数据太大跑不动,帮我改成 Dask 实现。
say.note: 会用 Dask DataFrame 或 Bag 重写并执行。

say.text: 用 Dask 分布式客户端并行处理这些日志文件。
say.note: 会启动分布式客户端并提交任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Dask to scale existing pandas/NumPy workflows beyond memory or across clusters. It splits work into chunks, processes them in parallel on cores or machines, and returns results via compute().
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to work with data larger than RAM, scale pandas/NumPy code to clusters, or process many files (CSV, Parquet, etc.) in parallel.

say_en.text: Use Dask to read all CSV files in the data directory and compute the mean.
say_en.note: Builds a lazy task graph and computes with compute().

say_en.text: My pandas code can't handle this data size, rewrite it with Dask.
say_en.note: Rewrites and runs as Dask DataFrame or Bag.

say_en.text: Process these log files in parallel with the Dask distributed client.
say_en.note: Starts a distributed client and submits tasks.
